_comment: The graphs inside smart-base's `L2` named subgraph, declared FROM WITHIN on the pattern of `../L1/graph.json` (owner, 2026-11-13: 'L1..L3 as named subgraphs', issue #359). Each entry is `subgraph: true`, a directory of the LAYER listed by `resolveDirectories` with `within: "smart-base-L2"`. Paths are relative to THIS directory. Declare only what exists.
name: L2

directories.description: Knowledge-graph layer L2, version 3.0: the Digital Adaptation Kit as nine components (DAK.fsh) and the elements inside them: the kit, personas, user scenarios, business processes and their tasks, data elements, decision-support and scheduling logic, programme indicators, functional and non-functional requirements with their statements, test scenarios, and the external artefacts they point at. Imports L1, and licenses the L1 -> L2 edges L1 cannot declare itself. `l2.ts` is the layer as migrated from WHO smart-kg 3f5e477, typed; `index.ts` exports it to the engine in `../../L1/schemas/`, and `generated/` holds the ontology JSON and the JSON-LD context. The FSH goes to the IG's `input/fsh/`.
